title: Northbeam TechWorks Plan Recovery Note: What a Plan Has Met on an Invoiced Job
content:
What the plan has met of the same work on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is read from the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans covering the item — its standing and the decision recorded against its claim — and, failing those, from what stands written off to the plan's cover on the job.

**Where the plan covering the item stands active and the decision recorded against its claim refused the claim**, nothing has been met by the plan.

**Where the plan stands active and that decision approved a repair**, what the plan has already paid out on the item has been met by it.

**Where neither situation holds**, what the plan has met of the same work is what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job.

## The readings side by side

| The plan covering the item | The decision recorded against its claim | What the plan has met |
| --- | --- | --- |
| standing active | refused the claim | nothing |
| standing active | approved a repair | what the plan has already paid out on the item |
| standing active | any other outcome recorded | what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job |
| not standing active | any | what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job |

A decision that approved a replacement, approved a reimbursement or was withdrawn by the customer is neither a refusal nor an approved repair, so it falls to the third line.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job or plan on file.*

**No plan standing active and nothing written off to the plan's cover.** Nothing has been met by the plan.

**No plan standing active, with a plan write-off on the job.** The 96.80 USD written off to the plan's cover on the job is what the plan has met.

**An approved repair on an active plan.** 318.40 USD having already been paid out on the item, 318.40 USD has been met by the plan.

**A refused claim on an active plan.** Nothing has been met by the plan, even where a write-off on the plan's cover stands on the job.
